messages:
ana: Quick question for the console team: can we surface a per-saved-query "rollout risk" indicator in the list view? idea is small: red/yellow/green based on predicted model swaps + quota exposure.

kevin: Yes please — we've had a couple support tickets where a saved view flipped to a fallback model mid-rollout and the owner didn't realize. A lightweight indicator would have caught it.

pri: Backend constraints: we can compute a heuristic: check (1) route has active canary percentage > 0, (2) org remaining quota < projected_monthly_cost, (3) fallback_chain length > 1. Score = simple sum of flags. All values are cheap to query.

mike: UX: in list view show tiny colored dot + hover text "risk: medium (canary + budget tight)". Click opens a small panel that shows preferred vs expected model and a one-line reason. Keep it non-blocking.

ana: small nit: make the dot clickable to toggle a one-time re-eval. Some customers will want to force re-simulate before sharing.

kevin: API idea: GET /api/v2/saved_queries/:id/risk_preview returns flat fields as strings: predicted_model, risk_level, reasons_comma_separated, cache_ttl_seconds. Example: {"predicted_model":"redwood/gpt-4o-base","risk_level":"medium","reasons":"canary,quota"} (we'll stringify).

pri: agree. Also recommend a bulk endpoint: POST /api/v2/saved_queries/bulk_risk -> {ids:[...]} returns list of compact strings. Bulk should be rate-limited and return partial if overloaded.

mike: we should avoid calling routing simulator per hover. caching makes sense. Default TTL 90s for stable routes, 4m for canary routes. Also add a subtle "last evaluated" timestamp in tooltip.

kevin: telemetry ask: attach preview_version_id to the saved_query when preview generated so we can join with real traffic and compute "swap_rate" where actual_model != predicted_model for the first 50 requests. Emit metric saved_query.swap_rate.

pri: RBAC: leave the preview open to view for everyone with saved_query.view, but restrict "re-eval" to roles with saved_query.edit to avoid spamming. Also put an audit entry when someone forces re-eval.

mike: UX flows: (1) list view dot + hover, (2) panel shows predicted vs preferred + one-line reason + link to "request re-eval", (3) if swap_rate > 0.15 show an inline yellow badge "rollout divergence" and a CTA "request pin" that opens a small form to ask infra to pin model for this query.

ana: pinned models are heavy. We should gate "request pin" behind org-level setting and notify infra channel with details.

pri: implementation detail: store preview metadata in separate table saved_query_previews with columns (saved_query_id, preview_version, predicted_model, reasons_csv, generated_at, cache_ttl_seconds). This keeps queries immutable and previews mutable.

kevin: ops-bot: create feature flag "saved-query-risk-dot" and default to off in prod.

ops-bot: Feature flag "saved-query-risk-dot" created, OFF in prod.

ana: next steps: pri to draft API contract and DB schema, mike to mock list dot + panel and re-eval flow, kevin to own telemetry metrics. We'll reconvene Wed. Thanks.
